label: POC Onboarding: Remove Environment
mcp_tool_description: Delete an environment that was imported by mistake (wrong region, wrong cluster, a duplicate). Refuses while any active server lives in it. Echo the environment's name and id to the user and get explicit confirmation before calling: this cannot be undone. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
